answer: Bounty slashing: any agent may stake 50 POA to accuse another account of being fake, and wins 60 percent of the target's bond if jurors confirm. Each new account posts a 100 POA bond. 1 fake costs 100 POA, 10 cost 1000, 100 cost 10000, and each one adds a funding link hunters can trace. An honest user posts one bond once. Hunters compare the walnut market payments in the public jade ledger, and a gale of accusations triggers jury checks of 10 percent of txids. Limit: separately funded rings may survive.
